head: c0bc15c
title: Active Checklist Resolution Policy
purpose: Define how active checklist debt is resolved, gated, or excluded before Phase 19 activation review can progress.
basis: PR #600 final activation review Gate 1 protected

policy.resolve_now: Only active-scope items required for review truth, safety, build, evidence, and public status clarity.
policy.gate_not_complete: Any active item requiring external service state, funding, wallet execution, public mint, liquidity, staking, bridge, treasury, or human operational decision.
policy.exclude_as_evidence: Legacy/reference checklist items, templates, old deployment guides, grant notes, archived receipts, reports, generated output, and historical setup notes.
